title: Beatrix and the Garden
author: Noor Marchetti
blurb: Marguerite Villalobos, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
